name: an_encounter
source:
You're on your way home, when suddenly... A stranger comes to talk to you. 

Grit your teeth, bear with it. You'll get through this. 

[From [url=https://studio-huis-clos.itch.io/an-encounter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正在回家的路上，突然……一个陌生人过来和你说话。

咬紧牙关，忍一忍。你会渡过这个难关的。

[来自[url=https://studio-huis-clos.itch.io/an-encounter]Itch.io[/url]]
